title: Senior Software Engineer, Client Platform

You'll establish engineering excellence through improved architecture, performance optimization, and maintainable code patterns that ensure our platform delivers exceptional experiences to both internal engineering teams and our 35+ million customers. This role is a unique opportunity to have immediate impact on the foundation that hundreds of Postman engineers rely on daily. What You'll Do The Client Platform team is a global engineering organization responsible for creating a "paved path" for all Postmanauts to develop and release web-based applications. Our platform is the foundation that hundreds of engineers at Postman rely on daily to deliver new features and improvements to over 30 million customers. We manage everything from build tooling and shared libraries to development infrastructure, best practices and our cross-platform desktop application. Specifically you will: Design and develop modular, well-documented SDKs and component libraries that serve both internal engineering teams as well as external developers, with focus on usability, accessibility, performance, and cross-platform compatibility. Architect extensible frontend systems with clear boundaries, well-defined interfaces, and appropriate abstraction layers that balance customization needs with consistency requirements Establish and evangelize architectural patterns that promote code quality, maintainability, and scalability across Postman's frontend ecosystem Champion engineering excellence through active participation in architectural decisions, mentorship of other engineers in frontend best practices, and creation of standards that become embedded in our engineering culture and measurably improve code quality Proactively partner with product and engineering to identify, prioritize, and eliminate technical debt through strategic refactoring and system enhancements, driving improved development velocity and platform reliability. Deep understanding of modern web technologies and best practices (JavaScript, TypeScript, React, state management, testing frameworks, etc.). Experience designing and implementing maintainable, scalable frontend architectures for complex applications, including component libraries and SDKs that can be effectively reused across multiple systems. Proven track record of raising the quality bar in previous roles through both technical solutions and positive cultural impact. Additionally, you are someone who: Communicates clearly and listens effectively. You seek new perspectives and build trust with your colleagues. Loves the challenge of constraints and excels at finding creative solutions. Takes ownership of problems, not solutions, and celebrates success as a team. Nice-to-have: Experience with cross-platform applications (Electron or similar) and understanding the unique challenges of desktop/web hybrid environments. title: Staff Software Development Engineer (Browser Extension/React)
description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. You'll turn product requirements and UI/UX designs into reliable, secure, and highly performant TypeScript that runs on millions of users' browsers without getting in their way. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone with strong engineering fundamentals who wants to grow their depth in browser-platform, security, and frontend engineering. title: High Speed IO Validation Engineer
description: NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the world’s most desirable employers in the technology field. Your bench is where silicon meets the signal — where every link train, jitter sweep, eye diagram, and protocol corner gets exercised before the part ships. You drive characterization and debug for IO interconnects across silicon, board, firmware, and driver — designing tests that anticipate rack-scale deployment so marginality surfaces at die-and-board scale, never in a rack. Engage with cross-functional engineering teams to facilitate the design and development process, leveraging your knowledge of firmware/driver interactions and circuit design. Analyze complex HSIO bugs by applying strong debugging techniques and collaborating with various teams for rapid resolution. Diagnose issues and validate high-speed interfaces using modern lab equipment, including DSOs and BERT, with expert-level proficiency. Develop and apply test/debug programs using scripting languages (such as Perl and Python) to perform stress and failure analysis on high-speed interfaces. Expert-level proficiency in electrical validation of PCIe (or similar) protocols, hands-on with lab equipment (DSOs, BERT, protocol analyzers), and scripting skills (Perl, Python) for developing test/debug programs. Proven experience in building AI solutions specifically in the context of electrical and silicon validation, including designing and implementing AI-assisted workflows and automation frameworks to enhance engineering productivity and validation quality. Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out. Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays. Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product. Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed. Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles. Cross-functional leadership Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support. Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities. Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity. Insights and storytelling Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached. Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst. Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.
